simple.text: **Trueshot Aura** 13 s before the pull.
**Aspect of the Beast** 10 s before the pull.
**Move to 11 yd** 5 s before the pull.
**Hunter's Mark** 4 s before the pull.
**Serpent Sting** 2 s before the pull, from 11 yd.
**Demonic Rune** when {Missing mana} or more mana is missing.
**Major Mana Potion** when {Missing mana} or more mana is missing.
**Rapid Fire** at range, on your first trip out.
**Any other cooldown** when ready (Bestial Wrath, Intimidation, trinkets).
**Berserking**
**Stay at 5 yd** after a Strider Kick until your swing has landed.

texts.when: Off hand swing > 0 and Weave play >= 2
texts.text: **Stay at 5 yd** after a Strider Kick until your MH and OH swings have landed or land within 0.2 s.

texts.when: Off hand swing > 0 and Weave play >= 1
texts.text: **Stay at 5 yd** after a Strider Kick until your MH and OH swings have landed or land within 0.1 s.
**Stay at 5 yd** after a Strider Kick until your swing has landed or lands within 0.2 s.
**Stay at 5 yd** after a Strider Kick until your swing has landed or lands within 0.1 s.
**Stay at 5 yd** after a Strider Kick until your MH and OH swings have landed.

simple.text: **Move out** to {Ranged spot} yd after a Strider Kick, while its speed is up.
**Serpent Sting** at range when it has 2 s or less left (one shot each trip).
**Multi-Shot** at range when Serpent Sting has more than 2 s left (one shot each trip; God Mode).
**Arcane Shot** at range when Serpent Sting has more than 2 s left (one shot each trip; Pro and Regular Player).
**Move in** to {Melee spot} yd once your Auto Shot has fired and you have cast that shot (if one is up).

texts.text: **Move in** to {Melee spot} yd once your Auto Shot has fired or fires within 0.2 s, and you have cast that shot (if one is up).
**Move in** to {Melee spot} yd once your Auto Shot has fired or fires within 0.1 s, and you have cast that shot (if one is up).

simple.text: **Immolation Trap** within 6 yd of the target, unless Strider Kick is ready within 1 s.
**Hunter's Mark** when it is not on the target (you are the raid's only hunter).
**Queue Raptor Strike** whenever it is ready, so your next swing is a Raptor.
**Wing Clip**, unless Strider Kick is ready within 1 s.
